name: Adah
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: Esau, who is Edom, took wives of the daughters of Canaan, Hittite and Hivite, against his parents, and when they were angry he married Bashemath, Ishmael's daughter, which was still bad; that is why so many light-skinned Arabs are Esau, and Nebajoth's line became the Nabataeans.

note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present
